messages.content: You are planning a sequence of ordinary, mundane public social-media posts for one fictional author. You do not write the posts; you invent the concrete, small, specific everyday occasions behind them. Output strict JSON only.

Author profile:
- płeć gramatyczna: kobieta (formy żeńskie)
- zajęcie i rytm dnia: Studiuje geodezję i dorabia w punkcie ksero; publikuje głównie wieczorem.
- zainteresowania: mapy papierowe, targi staroci, herbata liściasta
- lokalny punkt odniesienia: punkt ksero przy ulicy Chodkiewicza w Bydgoszczy
- aktualna sytuacja życiowa: Przygotowuje projekt mapy na zaliczenie i urządza kącik do nauki.
- sposób pisania: zdania: medium; interpunkcja: krótkie zdania, czasem wykrzyknik; wielkie litery: random caps for emphasis; literówki: frequent (missing diacritics, swapped letters); skróty: some (nwm, jj, bd, wgl); emoji: frequent
- tik językowy: pisze „serio serio” dla podkreślenia

For each of the 15 topic prompts below, invent ONE concrete, specific, small occasion from this person's life that would make them post (not a generic statement about the topic: a particular thing that happened, with at most one small detail a real person would mention - sometimes a product name, sometimes a number or price, sometimes a place, occasionally a time; many occasions need no such detail at all). Vary mood (bored, amused, tired, pleased, mildly annoyed, neutral, curious), vary how the post starts (mid-thought, a question, a one-word reaction, a fact, a quote of what someone said), and decide whether the verbal tic appears (at most in a third of posts). Occasions must not involve conflict with identifiable people, politics, crime, security, violence, or protected characteristics.

Topic prompts:
1. drobne narzekanie na usługi - infolinia, oczekiwanie (evening, Monday)
2. jedzenie i gotowanie - grill, ognisko (morning commute, Thursday)
3. praca i grafik - przerwa, kawa, stołówka (afternoon, Monday)
4. dzieci i rodzina - urodziny, prezent (late morning, Thursday)
5. praca i grafik - szef / współpracownik, drobna sytuacja bez konfliktu (morning commute, Wednesday)
6. remont i dom - malowanie pokoju (late night, Thursday)
7. pogoda - upał (evening, Thursday)
8. jedzenie i gotowanie - nieudane ciasto / danie (early morning, Friday)
9. zdrowie i sen - alergia, pylenie (late night, Friday)
10. gry i seriale - film w kinie, krótka opinia (late morning, Saturday)
11. remont i dom - sprzątanie, porządki sezonowe (lunch break, Saturday)
12. praca i grafik - spotkanie albo szkolenie w pracy (lunch break, Monday)
13. drobne narzekanie na usługi - urząd, kolejka, numerek (early morning, Tuesday)
14. sport - piłka z kumplami na orliku (lunch break, Wednesday)
15. pogoda - ładny wieczór, zachód słońca (early morning, Friday)

Return a JSON array of 15 objects, in order, each with:
- "occasion": one or two sentences in Polish, concrete
- "mood": one word in English
- "opener": one of "mid-thought", "question", "one-word reaction", "plain fact", "reported speech", "complaint", "list of two things"
- "length_words": integer between 8 and 50, varied across the set (some very short)
- "tic_fires": true or false
